newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay to add four flights/week to Osaka.
newsitem.headline: Cathay to add four flights/week to Osaka.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said on Wednesday it would add four new afternoon flights a week from Hong Kong to Osaka from February 2, bringing the total number of flights between the two cities to 25 a week.
The flights, using Airbus A330-300 aircraft, will depart Hong Kong on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday afternoons and return the following morning, it said.
The airline said it plans to increase the frequency of the new afternoon flights to daily service from June.
"Since the opening of Kansai International Airport in 1994, our flights to Osaka have been operating with higher and higher loads," said Tom Manwaring, route manager for North Asia.
